environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT Gateway, NO VPC endpoints for any AWS services, and NO Internet Gateway route in the subnet's route table. The only route entry is the local VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). An internal ALB in a separate private subnet (10.0.64.0/20) forwards traffic to the task on port 8080. The ALB itself is only reachable from a VPN-connected transit gateway attachment (TGW route: 172.16.0.0/12 via tgw-att-0x9f3a). DNS resolution within the VPC resolves only internal Route53 private hosted zones. No proxy, no sidecar, no outbound connectivity of any kind from the task subnet.

config.internet_gateway: not attached to task subnet route table
config.egress_path: none - no NAT, no IGW, no VPC endpoints, no proxy
